niche: Couples who keep having the same arguments with their partner and want to break the conflict cycle
problem: People repeatedly fight with their romantic partner or spouse and cannot break the cycle of conflict
reasoning: Six distinct relationship conflict searches (boyfriend, husband, girlfriend, partner, fiance, mom) signal a massive recurring need. The repetitive framing 'I keep fighting' indicates chronic pain, not a one-time issue. Digital guides on conflict scripts, de-escalation templates, and communication frameworks are highly sellable. Not dominated by a single mega-brand the way therapy apps are. Specific enough to build a focused product (e.g. scripts for the top 10 recurring couple fights).
